data.one_liner: Utilities and resolvers for responsive layouts and type-safe spacings in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides layout resolvers for different breakpoints (such as common desktop/tablet/phone or granular sizes) and type-safe spacing enums with context extensions. It helps handle responsive use-cases with minimal verbosity using custom layout builders.
use_when: You want to build responsive layouts with custom breakpoints based on max width constraints.
You need type-safe, consistent spacing across different device sizes in your application.
avoid_when: You prefer media-query based design systems without layout builders.
You already use a comprehensive alternative framework like responsive_framework.
strengths: Reduces verbosity when writing responsive layout conditions.
Provides built-in resolvers like CommonLayout and GranularLayout.
Offers type-safe spacing utilities and context extensions.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping your widget tree in custom resolver widgets.
Breakpoints are completely subjective and must be configured per project constraints.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive set of widgets for auto-scaling and responsive grid layouts globally across the app.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers screen type layout builders and device screen type utilities out of the box.

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Allows scaling UI based on device screen size using percentage-based extensions.
